name: Bulgor Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1/3 cup sliced cooked or canned mushrooms
instructions: Blend cooked Bulgor, mushrooms, green peppers, onion, salt, and pepper[cite: 202].
Place half of the Bulgor mixture in shallow casserole, cover with half the cheese slices[cite: 203].
Add the rest of the Bulgor mixture[cite: 204].
Cut remaining cheese slices diagonally in half; arrange on Bulgor mixture[cite: 204].
Bake in preheated moderate oven, 350°F, for 30 minutes[cite: 205].

name: Scalloped Bulgor with Wieners
ingredients: 1 can (10-1/2 oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Blend Bulgor, egg, onion, condensed soup, salt, and milk in a shallow baking dish [cite: 207-214].
Bake in moderate oven, 350°F, until mixture is partially set, about 30 minutes[cite: 215, 216].
Top with 5 to 6 wieners[cite: 217, 218].
Brush wieners with melted margarine or oil[cite: 219].
Continue baking until wieners are lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes[cite: 219].

name: Scotch Haggis with Bulgor
instructions: Simmer lamb hearts and liver in water to cover for 1-1/2 hours[cite: 221, 222].
Cool and put through food grinder[cite: 223].
Add minced suet, chopped onions, Bulgor wheat, salt, and meat broth [cite: 226-230].
Mix well and steam 3 hours in covered pudding mold[cite: 264].

name: Armenian Pilaf
instructions: Heat butter or margarine in heavy skillet[cite: 233].
Add onion and vermicelli or noodles; [cite_start]Sauté until lightly browned[cite: 234, 235].
Add Bulgor wheat, chicken stock, salt, and pepper[cite: 237].
Cover and simmer over low heat 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed. [cite_start]Stir occasionally[cite: 238].
After cooking, let stand 15 to 20 minutes before serving[cite: 239].

name: Boston Baked Bulgor
instructions: Blend all ingredients, except salt pork or bacon, in a 1-1/2 quart casserole[cite: 249].
Cut salt pork or bacon into strips 1/2 inch thick and press lengthwise into the surface of Bulgor mixture[cite: 250, 251].
Cover and Bake in slow oven, 325°F, 45 minutes[cite: 251].
Remove cover and continue Baking about 40 minutes[cite: 252].

name: Chinese Fried Bulgor
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely minced green bell pepper
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy skillet[cite: 254, 256].
Add onion, green bell pepper, and celery [cite: 257-259].
Sauté over moderate heat until onion is straw-coloured[cite: 260].
Stir in 2-1/2 cups cooked Bulgor wheat and 2 tablespoons soy sauce[cite: 261, 262].
Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes. [cite_start]Stir occasionally[cite: 263].
